boundary: The reflection generation and Molien identity are recomputed exactly from the repository group and character table. The names G12 and the polynomial-invariant implication use classical external theorems. This says nothing about the separate 24D signed carrier quotient.
headline: The exact faithful 2D GL2(3) clock representation is generated by its 12 order-two pseudoreflections. Its Molien series is exactly 1/((1-t^6)(1-t^8)). Thus the corrected 2D group is the reflection realization classically called Shephard-Todd G12, not an SL2 ADE group; the quotient C^2/G is smooth rather than an ADE surface singularity.
reconstruction_firewall: Wemyss-style finite-GL2 reconstruction algebras concern quotient surface resolutions in general. Here the faithful 2D action is a complex reflection group. By the Shephard-Todd-Chevalley theorem its invariant ring is polynomial, so C^2/G is smooth and there is no nontrivial exceptional ADE resolution graph to recover. The directed tensor quiver from Pass 11023 remains valid representation-ring data, but it should not be promoted to an ADE resolution quiver.
